systems.system: registration application system for children aged 0-5
systems.owner: National Identification Authority (NIA), in partnership with the Births and Deaths Registry and the Ghana Health Service
systems.tiers: selected hospitals and other health facilities; launched March 2024, suspended after a technical fault, tested again on 11 August 2026 ahead of a nationwide rollout

note: The system issues identity numbers to children aged 0 to 5 at health facilities and is the identification authority's; the document does not say it registers the birth or how the Births and Deaths Registry records one.
